C:S1.1.text: Lamar manages its operations through three operating segments: Billboard, which generates maximum revenue, Logo, and Transit Advertising.

C:S2.1.text: It is also a REIT: it generates revenues by leasing advertising space on billboards, buses, shelters, benches, logo plates, and in airport terminals.

C:S3.1.text: Lamar operates approximately 363,000 advertising displays in multiple states in the US and Canada as of December 2024.

C:S4.1.text: Lamar is described as the largest provider of logo signs in the US. These are the green highway-exit signs that list nearby gas, food, lodging, and camping options.

C:S5.1.text: Transit advertising covers airport terminals, bus shelters, benches, and buses.
